thread:
riley: ClearPath (HW SI) asked for an "observability bundle" for their on-prem appliance tile: Datadog + OpenTelemetry. They care about PII, license, and a short demo next Wed.

anika: We should recommend collector-side forwarding (collector -> Datadog) and include a masking example. Also a short one-pager for customers on "what stays local".

tom: Agreed. I'll own the demo harness and sample traces. Key span attrs: model.id, model.version, request_id, seq_len. We'll avoid storing raw prompts; use prompt.hash and prompt.length.

riley: Quick collector snippet for README (will sanitize in final):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  attributes/transform:
    actions:
      - action: delete
        key: http.request.body
      - action: delete
        key: user.email
exporters:
  datadog:
    apikey: "<DD_APIKEY_PLACEHOLDER>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes/transform]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

anika: Dashboard notes: show GPU utilization, request.qps, p50/p95 latency, trace flamegraph. Add a tenant selector and an alert template for high p95 latency > 500ms over 5m. Also include a 20s GIF for the marketplace tile.

tom: Canary plan: I'll deploy harness to staging Mon, validate traces arrive to Datadog staging org Tue. Will post repo link and minimal logs.

dev-bot: deploy: cp-observability-harness v0.1 deployed to staging (tag: clearpath-2026-03)

anika: One-pager draft: "Telemetry stays on-prem by default. Customers can opt to forward sanitized, sampled traces to Datadog for monitoring. We recommend 1% sampling, 100% for errors during incidents." Legal: no partner logos until signoff.

riley: Owners/timeline: Tom = demo harness + traces (Mon), Anika = dashboard + one-pager (Tue AM), Riley = marketplace PR + packaging (Tue EOD).

tom: noted. Will also include mapping rule to convert span attribute model.version -> Datadog tag model_version.

anika: Add preflight checklist for customers: open port 4317, check otelcol status, datadog-agent status, and collector config path.

riley: Thanks team. I'll open the PR and tag ClearPath for review. :thumbsup:
